correctness.rationale: An analytic proof identifies the full mean-zero scalar support space with directions using the \(d+1\)-atom weighted orthogonal frame; every cubic stationary point is two-valued and its Bernoulli skewness is controlled exactly by the least mass. Parseval for complete one-step predictable representation yields \(H^2=\mathbb E\|X\|^4-d=\sum_i p_i^{-1}-3(d+1)+2\). Strict convexity of reciprocals gives the sharp conditional lower and upper envelopes and equality profiles; interpolation on a fixed-minimum-mass face fills every value. Finite support ensures uniform Fourier expansion. Executed verify.py from its actual directory: 49,319 exact-rational or deterministic numeric checks including Gram contractions, endpoint/interior cases, spectral grid, and weak-Fourier limits. Finite checks do not prove arbitrary d; analytical steps do.

originality.rationale: Assessed contribution is the complete joint attainable spectral–Hilbert–Schmidt region of the third-moment tensor of minimally supported isotropic martingale increments, together with its sharp distinct extremal probability profiles. The published scalar fixed-mass skewness theorem covers the one-dimensional skewness optimizer used in Step 2; no claim of originality is made for that ingredient. Tanaka supplies only qualitative cubic nonvanishing and nonzero Fourier weak error; Attal–Deschamps–Pellegrini supply the underlying tensor and simplex geometry. None of the inspected statements gives the conditional full two-tensor-norm region. Targeted published-record and primary-source comparisons found no dominating whole-claim result; remaining unindexed literature risk is recorded.
residual_risks: The cubic spectral formula by itself is mathematically covered by published fixed-probability scalar skewness extremization; the claim of originality depends on the complete joint spectral–Hilbert–Schmidt attainable region, not this ingredient.

The tensor-energy identity and envelope optimization use classical obtuse geometry and reciprocal convexity. Another source could have carried out the same combined calculation even though it was not located; novelty is not independently certified.
The accessible sections of the older tensor literature were materially read, but exhaustive historical literature review was not possible.
Numerical checking supports sampled finite configurations only; proof covers the universal hypotheses.

value.rationale: The two natural cubic metrics represent worst-direction and aggregate third-order errors for minimally supported weak Brownian schemes with exact scalar martingale representation. Complete fixed-spectral attainable intervals, strict equality-profile classification, an exact chi-square stability identity, and a dimension-order gap between the squared aggregate extremes provide motivated structural design information unavailable from scalar skewness extremization alone. The theorem is a complete all-dimensional feasible-region classification rather than an isolated calculation or a routine tiny parameter gain.
